title: Easy hike Valbondione -> Rif. Curo (+ optional Barbellino stroll)
terrain: ~7km, ~900m D+, pack; optional flat 3-4km around the lake

steps.target: Z1, optional relaxed stroll at the lake

coachNotes: Recovery-pace day, the only goal is arriving at Curo fresh for tomorrow. You felt weak Friday evening: if that feeling returns on the climb, slow down further, there is no time target. Big dinner, hydrate, early night. Skip the lake stroll without guilt if legs say so.
